extracted.name: Magic Bars
extracted.description: This easy Magic Bars recipe (7 Layer Bars) has a graham cracker crust topped with layers of chocolate, butterscotch, chopped heath bars, nuts, and shredded coconut. They are simple, quick, and everyone's favorite dessert!
ingredient_lines: 2 (1.4 oz) heath bars (, chopped (or 1 cup toffee bits))
instruction_lines: Crust: Crush graham crackers in the sleeve, using a food processor, or rolling pin. Mix with melted butter and pour mixture into a greased 8’’ square baking dish.
Layer: Sprinkle crust with chocolate chips, then butterscotch chips, chopped heath bars, nuts and coconut. Pour sweetened condensed evenly over the top.
Bake at 350 degrees F for 30-35 minutes. Allow to cool before serving. I like to refrigerate them before cutting and serving, so they're easier to handle.
categories: 7 layer magic bars by eagle brand
